topics.purpose: Define exact alias uniqueness, scope, deprecation and target semantics.

semantics.target_rule: Alias maps to one exact canonical id.
semantics.canonical_rule: Alias cannot shadow active canonical id.
semantics.scope_rule: Scoped alias requires explicit scope profile.
semantics.deprecation_rule: Deprecated aliases remain explicit until retired.

invariants.rule: Every conformance rule has exact identity, scope, inputs, predicate/evaluation semantics, severity/blocking behavior and finding representation.
Conformance rules never rely on newest-wins, mtime, filename similarity, path proximity, UI layout, fuzzy identity matching or undocumented implementation defaults.
